attempts.answer:
<thought>Garchomp runs a fast Swords Dance set with Garchompite to break through leads, while Dragapult uses Dragon Darts + U-turn as a fast pivot with Choice Scarf. Kingambit cleans late-game with Supreme Overlord Sucker Punch, and Gholdengo's Good as Gold blocks status while Nasty Plot boosts. Rotom-Wash pivots with Volt Switch and burns physical attackers, and Primarina checks Dragons with bulky Calm Mind + Leftovers.</thought>
